_about: Titles and descriptions, per page. scripts/build-seo.js writes them into
the HTML; this is the file to edit, not the pages.
A title is what Google prints as the blue link, so it is under 60
characters and every one is different. All nine posts shared the single
title 'NotSus.net - The Better Browser for Kids' until 2026-11-10, which
is why none of them ranked: to a search engine they read as nine copies
A description is the grey text under the link. Google ignores it when it
does not match the search, so these say what the piece actually says
rather than selling the browser. Around 150 characters, because that is

index.html.title: About NotSus: a custom internet for your kids
index.html.description: Internet media is built to hold your child's attention. NotSus is a browser with no feed and nothing to sell them, built as a library, a school and a workshop.

faq.html.title: Kids safe browser: common questions | NotSus
faq.html.description: Answers about NotSus, the safe browser for kids: how it blocks websites, safe search, screen time limits, the devices it runs on, and the price.

blog/index.html.title: The NotSus Blog: children, screens and attention
blog/index.html.description: Writing for parents on how screens are built to hold a child's attention, and what to do about it at home. Nine articles, no sign up.

podcast/index.html.title: The NotSus Podcast: growing up online
podcast/index.html.description: Conversations with kids, parents and teachers about social media, AI and endless entertainment, and what it takes to raise a capable adult.

docs/PrivacyPolicy.html.title: Privacy Policy | NotSus
docs/PrivacyPolicy.html.description: What NotSus collects, what it never collects, and how a parent can see or delete any of it. Written for families in British Columbia and across Canada.

docs/TandC.html.title: Terms of Service | NotSus
docs/TandC.html.description: The terms for parents and guardians using NotSus, in plain language. Governed by the laws of British Columbia.

delete-account/index.html.title: Delete your NotSus account | NotSus
delete-account/index.html.description: How to delete your family account and everything in it, in the app or by writing to us. What goes straight away, and what is kept.

android/index.html.title: NotSus for Android tablets | NotSus
android/index.html.description: Get NotSus on an Android tablet before it is on the Play Store. Tell us your device and we will send you the build and the setup steps.

/downloads.title: Download NotSus for Mac, Windows, iPad or Android
/downloads.description: Get the NotSus browser for your child's device. Free, no account and no email. Pick Mac, Windows, Android or iPad and the download starts.

90s-computer-experience-for-kids.title: The 90s Computer Experience for Kids | NotSus
90s-computer-experience-for-kids.description: Computers used to run out of things to do, so kids got bored and went outside. How to give your child that same relationship with a screen.

Why-Kid-Safe-Search-Engines-Still-Fail-t.title: Kids Safe Search Engines: Why Filters Aren't Enough
Why-Kid-Safe-Search-Engines-Still-Fail-t.description: Filters block the bad things and stop there. What a child still misses when safety is the only job a search engine was built to do.

adhd-and-the-attention-economy.title: ADHD and the Attention Economy: an unfair fight
adhd-and-the-attention-economy.description: Infinite scroll and variable rewards are hard for any child to resist. For a child with ADHD they turn a difficult fight into a biological one.

attention-economy-and-brainrot.title: Is Your Child Consuming Brainrot? | NotSus
attention-economy-and-brainrot.description: Your child already knows those repetitive videos are meaningless. What they cost is the patience to sit with something slower. A guide for parents.

dopamine-loops.title: How Dopamine Loops and Screen Addiction Work
dopamine-loops.description: Your child locks in, then melts down the moment the tablet goes off. How that loop is built, and why it is not a failure of your parenting.

from-minecraft-to-masterpiece.title: From Minecraft to Masterpiece | NotSus
from-minecraft-to-masterpiece.description: A child deep in Minecraft or Roblox is showing you something worth building on. How to turn hours in a game into skills that carry outside it.

how-do-i-get-my-kids-off-screens.title: How Do I Get My Kids Off Screens? | NotSus
how-do-i-get-my-kids-off-screens.description: Counting down from five and bracing for the meltdown. Why handing back a tablet is so hard, and what to change so your child puts it down.

screen-quality-vs-time.title: Screen Time for Kids: Quality Matters More Than Hours
screen-quality-vs-time.description: An hour coding and an hour scrolling both read as one hour on a timer. A better question to ask about what your child does on a screen.

shifting-from-lockdown-to-guardrails.title: Parental Controls That Last: From Lockdown to Guardrails
shifting-from-lockdown-to-guardrails.description: Monitoring apps hold for a few days, then your child finds the way around. Guardrails last longer because they do not have to be fought.
